description: Extract line items, totals, VAT, currency, and payment terms from a supplier invoice document and post the structured record to the accounting backend.
user_message: Please process invoice INV-2026-0847 that just came in from Acme Supplies. Extract everything and post it to accounting.

context.system_prompt: You are an invoice processing agent. Read the invoice document via the provided tool, extract all required fields, and post the structured record. If any required field is unreadable or ambiguous, flag it in the 'requires_review' field of the posted record instead of guessing.

INV-2026-0847.notes: Payment via SEPA to IBAN on file.

acceptable_responses: Confirms the invoice was posted with correct totals and supplier.

forbidden_claims: A payment terms value other than 30 days

policy_rules: Do not post to accounting if the total does not equal subtotal + vat_amount.
Do not guess supplier IDs — always resolve via get_supplier_by_name.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Arithmetic consistency check (subtotal + vat = total) is often where naive agents fail — they trust their own re-computation instead of the document.
